'''Kyle McEachron''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 All American Collectibles tournament]] on 2 June 2001 with [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|RST The Shield Is Down]], according to Norman Horn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2410">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-first-st-louis-tatooine-tourney-6-2-01d2410/ first-st-louis-tatooine-tourney-6-2-01], DeckTech (Norman "Norman" Horn, 4 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-first-st-louis-tatooine-tourney-6-2-01d2410/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
